bio: Lisa Frances Kinney (born 1950/1951) is an American politician and attorney. She represented the 9th district and the Albany County district in the Wyoming Senate from 1985 to 1995 and served as minority leader from 1992 to 1994. Kinney is the Democratic nominee for Wyoming's at-large congressional district in 2026.
